files.modifications: Decode table (map bytes 256..511) as a TypeScript constant with a synchronous Buffer decode; no encoder, no fetch.

Type-only extraction of Risu's file-format shapes; enums and `as const` maps reduced to literal unions, the `triggerscript` alias resolved, no runtime code, and the MIT character-card spec types split out into ccardlib-types.ts.

The CBS function registry, copied from `matcherArg` onward. `defaultCBSRegisterArg` and the svelte-store imports are dropped; CBSRegisterArg gains getTriggerId(), now(), random() and unsupported(name), so the trigger store, every bare `new Date()`, every `Math.random()`, `window.inner*` and `navigator.language` go through injected dependencies; Node's `Buffer` in {{file}}, {{xor}} and {{xordecrypt}} is replaced by the base64 helpers in cbs-support.ts. Evaluation semantics are unchanged; `@ts-nocheck` keeps the non-strict upstream bodies intact.

Only the CBS evaluator of parser.svelte.ts: risuEscape/risuUnescape, initMatcher, matcher, dateTimeFormat, legacyBlockMatcher, parseArray/parseDict/makeArray, blockStartMatcher, trimLines, blockEndMatcher and risuChatParser. Markdown, DOMPurify, katex, highlight.js and asset rendering are not copied. The module-level matcher map becomes one map per `createRisuCbs(deps)` instance, every app-state and environment read becomes a member of the injected RisuCbsDeps, and an added unsupported-name channel reports names listed in deps.unsupportedNames as well as names with no registration (which stay literal, as upstream). Two optional safety hooks were added to RisuCbsDeps, since upstream bounds neither running time nor produced text: `maxOutputChars` aborts once one parse's nested buffers plus its {{#each}} growth of the source pass the limit, checked every main-loop iteration, and `checkBudget()` is called every 256 iterations and at every recursive risuChatParser entry so the host can abort by throwing; both abort through one sticky flag the main loop re-raises, and parse reports an abort as RisuCbsResult.error with the input text returned unchanged. `@ts-nocheck` keeps the non-strict upstream bodies intact.

Pure helpers the CBS evaluator needs: parseKeyValue, sfc32, pickHashRand and safeStructuredClone (its rfdc fallback replaced by a JSON deep copy), calcString as createCalcString(accessors), and chatVar.svelte.ts's default-variable fallback as createChatVarAccessors(store). Adds base64 helpers that replace Node's Buffer in cbs.ts, and declares the narrowed `Database` and `LLMModel` shapes the evaluator reads, neither of which is in types.ts. Type-checks under strict; no @ts-nocheck.

Character-card spec types of the @risuai/ccardlib 0.4.2 package RisuAI depends on; the package's runtime declarations and CharacterCardV1 are dropped and the inline asset literal is named CharacterCardV3Asset. The package ships no LICENSE file, so its package.json "license": "MIT" is the licensing statement on record.

Only `parseDecorators` of the @risuai/ccardlib 0.4.2 bundle RisuAI calls as `CCardLib.decorator.parse`; the card version checks and the V1/V2/V3 and lorebook converters are not copied. The published file is minified, so the function was expanded back to readable form with its one-letter locals renamed and the published declaration's types applied; no statement, condition or order changed. The package ships no LICENSE file, so its package.json "license": "MIT" is the licensing statement on record.

`convertCharbook` copied whole and exported, with `checkNullish` inlined, so the `@@` lines it prepends are byte-identical to Risu's; it still mutates the entries it is given. It reads no app state upstream, so nothing became a parameter. The decorator hook of `getLoreBook` becomes the pure `interpretLoreDecorators(content)`: every mutation of the activation loop's locals is recorded in a returned record instead, and the activation loop itself (key search, recursion, token budget, chat-variable reads and writes) is not copied. Hook return values (`return` vs `return false`) are kept exactly so the `@@@` fallback chain still works. One added guard: a bare `@@position` is rejected instead of throwing a TypeError. Type-checks under strict; no @ts-nocheck.

`loadLoreBookV3Prompt` as the pure, synchronous `activateLore`: matching rules, query order, recursion, sort, greedy token filter and inject merge copied statement for statement, with every app-state read turned into a field of LoreActivationInput/LoreActivationDeps. The decorator switch is not re-copied; lorebook.ts's `interpretLoreDecorators` record is read back into the upstream locals. matchLog is not returned, so its `prompt` field and everything feeding it (db.username, msg.name, findCharacterbyId, char.name) is dropped; only `source` survives, as the input to the added `matchedBy`. setChatVar becomes `variableWrites`, the :637 console.log is dropped, and `index`/`matchedBy`/`omitted` are added. Type-checks under strict; no @ts-nocheck.
